text:
jess_sales: Quick sync - FinServ X asks for BYO CloudHSM for the POC. Requirements: HSM-backed keys, envelope encryption, quarterly rotation, and an auditable key-ceremony record. What do we need from them to get SOW signed?

mike_se: Minimal items from customer: CloudHSM cluster id + region, VPC peering CIDR + subnets, IAM role ARN (wrap/unwrap perms), and a contact for the ceremony. Also confirm whether keys will be CloudHSM-generated or uploaded by them.

jess_sales: They confirmed CloudHSM-generated keys (AWS). Contact: sara@finservx.com. They want an estimate for any BYO surcharge for a 1-month POC.

oliver_eng: For a short POC: we usually waive per-token BYO surcharges. Chargeable items: integration engineering time and any dedicated capacity if they request isolated pools. SOW line-item: one-time integration fee plus pass-through infra costs. We never persist unwrapped private keys.

anya_security: Security checklist for the security questionnaire:
- Attestation: CloudHSM cluster certs or, for POC, a signed attestation from their security lead.
- Key policy: must include a Redwood service principal with kms:WrapKey/kms:UnwrapKey.
- Ceremony artifacts: signed PDF + checksum; retention requested (we recommend 7 years for regulated customers).
- Rotation cadence: quarterly supported; Redwood can orchestrate rotation via our rotation API but ceremony must be run by customer or an approved delegate.

mike_se: I'll draft a compact runbook. Network steps we'll require to test wrap/unwrap:
1) Create CloudHSM in us-west-2 and provision in a private subnet.
2) Provide VPC peering details and allow outbound to our integration IPs (we'll share list).
3) Create IAM role ARN and attach minimal KMS policy.
4) Create a test key alias and confirm expected TTL for the POC.

jess_sales: SOW snippet I can paste into contract?

oliver_eng: Paste this into the SOW: 
```
POC BYO-KMS integration (CloudHSM):
- Scope: Integration with customer-managed AWS CloudHSM using envelope encryption.
- Deliverables: network integration checklist, integration runbook, one key-ceremony facilitation session, rotation verification test.
- Assumptions: Customer provides CloudHSM access, VPC peering, IAM role, and attestation docs. Redwood will not store unwrapped private keys.
- Pricing: one-time integration fee (see quote), plus any dedicated capacity or egress charges.
```

mike_se: Typical numbers we have used: $6,000 one-time integration fee for a short POC (engineering + runbook). If they want dedicated dedicated pools / guaranteed SLA during POC, add reserved-capacity line (monthly pro-rated).

anya_security: Two clarifying Qs for their GRC folks: do they require multi-party key generation (MPC or HSM key splitting) for prod? And confirm artifact retention window (they agreed 7 years earlier?).

sara_finservx: Confirming: POC will use CloudHSM-generated keys, no multi-party generation required for POC. 7-year retention for ceremony artifacts is fine. We can do a ceremony Wed 10am PT.

jess_sales: Great. @mike_se @oliver_eng please confirm the pre-ceremony network checklist we can send to Sara before Wed. I'll update the draft SOW with the $6k integration fee and add them to the JIRA.

oliver_eng: I'll post a minimal terraform/VPC peering snippet and the IAM policy snippet by EOD. Minimal IAM example we'll send:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDSRV:role/redwood-integration" },
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:WrapKey","kms:UnwrapKey"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/*"
    }
  ]
}
```

deploy-bot: POC sandbox cluster provisioned (id: rbw-poc-746) - integration tests ready. :rocket:

mike_se: I'll own the runbook and test plan; sending first draft to the thread and to sara@finservx.com by EOD.

jess_sales: Thanks everyone, this unblocks SOW. Sara, I'll push the contract update and calendar invite for Wed once I get Oliver's network doc.
